svg.title: E - Decision disagreement across data-consistent models
svg.desc: rural3, P1 and P3, per near condition, replicate 0. y = Sum(e)/Sum(e_B5) of B2 and of its 4 random data-consistent alternatives (moving-block bootstrap refits of the non-negative ridge, s. 8); voltage-unsafe alternatives are drawn as crosses. n = 10 conditions x 4 alternatives per panel. No uncertainty is shown: every point is one AC-scored envelope. The 4 extreme alternatives are not drawn because they collapse onto the centre fit: every realised shrink factor is 0 (P1 [0.0], P3 [0.0]), so their export spread is 0 and is an upper bound, not a measured disagreement. Source: results/ambiguity_rural3.json, results/envelopes_rural3.json and runs/oracle_rural3.npz. Contains information from SimBench (simbench.de), made available under the Open Database License (ODbL 1.0). See analysis/export_envelope_shift/DATA_ATTRIBUTION.md.
